title: hybrid.rs: Yggdrasil /7 prefix check only matches /8
description: Line 246 checks `addr[0] == 0x02` but the spec (04-network.md) defines 0200::/7 which includes both 0x02 and 0x03 first bytes. The Python impl uses `(first_byte & 0xFE == 0x02)` and gateway.rs uses `dst[0] & 0xfe == 0x02`. Addresses starting with 0x03 would be misclassified as External instead of MeshLocal, causing incorrect routing via border router instead of mesh routing. Fix: change to `(addr[0] & 0xFE) == 0x02`.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed addr[0] == 0x02 to addr[0] & 0xfe == 0x02 in hybrid.rs line 246 to correctly match 0200::/7 prefix (covers both 0x02xx and 0x03xx). This aligns with gateway.rs and Python implementation.
